## Useful resources

### Data visualization

- [Stata visual library](https://worldbank.github.io/stata-visual-library/)
- [R visual library](https://worldbank.github.io/r-econ-visual-library/)
- [An Economist’s Guide to Visualizing Data](https://gouvci-my.sharepoint.com/:b:/g/personal/j_migone_stat_plan_gouv_ci/EaRbnR7TnC5PuEZwnGvOtAgB6QXQmq6qmWWLa4oVB7dR1g?e=QFUw3M)

### Books, talks & explainers

- [Causality for the Brave and True](https://matheusfacure.github.io/python-causality-handbook/landing-page.html), a practical causal-inference handbook.
- [Econimate](https://t.co/5O0ziYSjJy), animated explanations of economics research.
- [Public speaking for academic economists](https://gouvci-my.sharepoint.com/:b:/g/personal/j_migone_stat_plan_gouv_ci/EbLOkKzRI5tNs2JG9tTGwFoBXj5IbXdcpepUSA_MRmcjjg?e=8mnZ5F), by Rachael Meager.
- [Microsimulating the impact of public policies on households](https://gouvci-my.sharepoint.com/:b:/g/personal/j_migone_stat_plan_gouv_ci/EbLOkKzRI5tNs2JG9tTGwFoBXj5IbXdcpepUSA_MRmcjjg?e=YH6Qcw) (in French).
